author: docs/auditor
content:
When conducting Tier-2 technical documentation audits:
1. Always parse all runnable CLI code snippets in markdown and HTML with core.py build_parser(). It instantly catches missing required flags (--mission, --content) that manual visual skimming overlooks.
2. In sequence diagrams (Mermaid), verify participant arrows for local CLI lookups (e.g. whois) to ensure they do not depict unnecessary network hops to orchestrators.
3. Use python html.parser to verify HTML tag balancing and regex to ensure zero external CDN/font dependencies.
title: Audit Methodology: AST/Parser Verification of Docs CLI Snippets
